title: 第19章 钱必须拿下第20章 咬住唇瓣
slug: 共梦后被顶级凶兽们亲哭了
lines: 医生也不敢冒动。
可是丁管事没有那么好的耐心。
医生也只能哆嗦着往笼子里伸手。
苏芽芽为他默哀。
这不得让半兽人直接一拳攮死啊？
她有些不忍直视地避开了眼睛。
可是预想中的惨叫没有发生。
苏芽芽转眼一看，医生胳膊短，个头也不高，就算把手臂伸直，也碰不到半虎兽人。
半虎兽人就只是一动不动地站在那。
医生又怯懦又不得不伸手去碰半兽人的样子。
苏芽芽品出些许心酸，可是她也不能过去帮忙。
她这点骨头，半兽人随便动动手指，她都能噶成碎片。
“你让他配合一下。”丁管事低声对苏芽芽吩咐。
苏芽芽觉得医生应该给丁管事看看脑子。
半兽人听她的？
开什么玩笑。
但是丁管事说话了，她就得照做。
“你配合一下？”苏芽芽努力挤出一点笑意。
她甚至都也不知道自己为什么要笑着说。
好像这样显得和气一些？
可半虎兽人压根没理她。
苏芽芽转眼看到丁管事扫过来暗含警告的眼神，缩了缩脖子。
她这不是按照他的指示做了吗？
可不能因为这点事，打她啊！
苏芽芽下意识往旁边挪开些。
丁管事咬咬牙，就知道她这脑子是指望不上的。
“你去跟他说怎么配合医生。”丁管事没好气地翻白眼。
他都想扒开苏芽芽的脑子看看构造。
“哦。”苏芽芽有了明确的指示，点点头转头看向半虎兽人。
她深吸一口气。
尽管她觉得这样很像个傻子。
但是不做，鞭子就会抽身上。
孰轻孰重，苏芽芽心里有数。
content_en:
The doctor didn't dare to take any chances.
But Manager Ding doesn't have that much patience.
The doctor could only reach into the cage tremblingly.
Su Yaya mourned for him.
Shouldn't this allow the orc to be punched to death?
She averted her eyes unbearably.
But the expected scream did not happen.
Su Yaya took a quick look and saw that the doctor had short arms and was not tall. Even if he straightened his arms, he could not touch the half-tiger orc.
The half-tiger orc just stood there motionless.
The doctor looked timid and had to reach out to touch the orc.
Su Yaya felt a little sad, but she couldn't go over to help.
With so few bones in her body, any orc could break her into pieces with just a simple move of his fingers.
"Ask him to cooperate." Manager Ding whispered to Su Yaya.
Su Yaya felt that the doctor should take a look at Manager Ding's brain.
Orcs listen to her?
What a joke.
But when Steward Ding said something, she had to do it.
"Will you cooperate?" Su Yaya tried her best to smile.
She didn't even know why she was smiling.
Doesn't it seem more friendly?
But the half-tiger orc ignored her at all.
In a blink of an eye, Su Yaya saw Manager Ding glance at her with a hint of warning, and she shrank her neck.
Didn't she follow his instructions?
But you can't beat her because of this!
Su Yaya subconsciously moved aside.
Manager Ding gritted his teeth, knowing that she couldn't rely on her brain.
"Tell him how to cooperate with the doctor." Manager Ding rolled his eyes angrily.
He wanted to open Su Yaya's brain and see its structure.
"Oh." Su Yaya had clear instructions, nodded and turned to look at the half-tiger orc.
She took a deep breath.
Even though she felt like a fool.
But if you don't do it, the whip will hit you.
Which one is light and which one is serious? Su Yaya knows it well.
title_en: Chapter 19 The money must be taken Chapter 20 Bite your lip
